items.name: Circle-Friend's Charm
items.lore: A pebble from the stone circle above the lake.

items.name: Lulling Belt
items.lore: Dara's tune is stitched along it in blue thread.

items.name: Stone-Keeper's Torc
items.lore: Grey stone and silver. Only a Stone-Keeper wears it.

items.name: Lake-Sleep Bracer
items.lore: It keeps the wearer's sleep as the Circle keeps the lake's.

items.name: Mantle of Lough Gur
items.lore: Lake-grey, with Aine's comb in silver at the clasp. Only a Keeper of Lough Gur wears it.
